“可不是嘛，四哥，你把名额给老二，我们是替你觉得不值，王卓那孩子刚才说的对，虎子一定比铁柱强，说不定真能被仙人收入。”铁柱他爹的五弟，在一旁接茬道。
王卓得意的一笑，添油加醋的说道：“这一切都是他们一家人自找的，我和我爹之前就劝过，可没用啊，他们一家人都是驴脾气，倔啊，现在撞墙了，赖谁啊。”
王浩面露不忍之色，说道：“铁柱他……”
没等他说完，王浩他爹狠狠的瞪了他一眼，王浩语气一滞，轻叹一声，不再插嘴。
铁柱四叔暗叹，沉声道：“谁再提此事，就是和我老四过不去，这事就这么结了，铁柱这孩子没被选中，只能说是没有福分，与其他无关，铁柱，你也别放在心里，实在不行就跟四叔出去，嘿嘿，仙人门派四叔说不上话，可若是江湖上的凡人门派，四叔讨个面子，还是可以的，到时你和你弟弟虎子一起去，我本就打算把他送到江湖上的门派历练一番。”
王卓一听这话，立刻大笑，轻蔑的说道：“铁柱，我看四叔说的行，你去吧，到时候就和人家说，你是被仙人淘汰下来的废物，说不定人家一听这话，立刻就收你了呢。”
王林缓缓抬起头来，漆黑的眸子木然的在周围那些嘲讽的亲戚身上扫过，最终放在王卓身上，一字一字说道：“王卓，你听好，我王林此生，绝对会踏入仙人门派，你和你爹对我们一家人的嘲讽，我会一一记在心头。”
王卓冷笑，正要讥讽，四叔眉头一皱，对王卓喝道：“小兔崽子，你他妈在啰嗦，我现在就废了你，把你弄成白痴，我就不信到时仙人还会要你！”
王卓父亲面色大变，急忙上前把王卓拉在身后，疾言厉色道：“老四，你敢！”
四周的亲戚，全都面带冷笑，看着眼前的一幕。
铁柱四叔哈哈大笑，目中寒光闪烁，低沉道：“哦？大哥，你说我不敢？”
铁柱父亲连忙上前拉住老四，急道：“老四，听二哥的，你家里有老婆孩子，犯不上为二哥这样，你心意二哥这辈子铭记在心，老四，你送我一程，我和你嫂子带铁柱回家。”
铁柱四叔盯着王卓父亲，冷笑几声，随后深深的看了自己二哥一眼，点了点头，拉着铁柱，与铁柱父母离开了大宅子。
远远，王林耳边隐约还能听到院子里亲戚们的嘲讽之声。
坐在四叔的马车中，一家人踏上回家的路程。
马车内一阵寂静，铁柱父亲内心感叹，说不失望那是假的，可铁柱毕竟是他儿子，他暗叹一声，开口道：“铁柱，这算啥，没事，你爹当初被赶出家门的时候，比你还沮丧，后来不也一样坚持下来了么，你听爹的，回家好好读书，明年大考争取考个好成绩，若是不喜欢读书了，就和你四叔出去散散心。”
铁柱娘爱怜的望着自己儿子，劝慰道：“铁柱，你可别做傻事，娘只有你这一个孩子，你要是有个三长两短，娘也不想活了，娃儿，你要坚强啊。”说着说着，她眼泪就流了下来。
王林望着爹娘，点头说道：“爹，娘，你们放心吧，我不会做傻事的，我有打算，你们不用操心了。”

铁柱那娘把铁柱搂在怀里，低声道：“铁柱啊，一切都过去了，咱不想这事了。”
母亲温暖的怀抱，让王林心灵的伤口渐渐有了愈合的迹象，王林这几天太累了，心力憔悴，疲惫不堪，随着马车的跌宕起伏，他渐渐睡着了。
他做了一个梦，梦见自己成为了仙人，带着父母在天空上飞来飞去……
深夜，铁柱醒了，他看着四周熟悉的小屋，轻叹一声，目光闪动，内心的打算更加坚定。出了小屋，他向爹娘的房间深深的望了一眼，拿起纸笔留下一封书信，揣着足够的干粮，离开了家门。
“求仙之路，我不会放弃，恒岳派，我一定要再去尝试一下！即便还是不收，也一定要打听到其他仙人门派所在位置。”王林目光坚定，背着包裹，离开了山村，向外走去。
此时月光铺路，星痕指向，把王林的背影拉着很长，很长……
三天后，王林行走在偏僻的山路上，他当日被张姓青年夹在腋下，睁开眼睛的一刻隐约看到大致的方向。
一直向东，王林不顾杂草割破双腿，坚持不懈的前行。

"Isn't that right? Fourth brother, you gave the spot to the second child. We feel it's not worth it for you. That kid Wang Zhuo just said was right. Hu Zi must be better than Tiezhu, and maybe he can really be accepted by the immortal." Tiezhu's father's fifth brother continued at the side.
Wang Zhuo smiled proudly and said with added jealousy: "The whole family brought this on themselves. My father and I have tried to persuade them before, but it's no use. They are all stubborn and stubborn. Now they've hit a wall. Who can we blame?"
Wang Hao showed an unbearable look on his face and said, "Tiezhu..."
Before he could finish speaking, Wang Hao's father glared at him fiercely. Wang Hao's tone was stagnant, he sighed softly, and stopped interrupting.
Tiezhu's fourth uncle secretly sighed and said in a deep voice: "Whoever mentions this matter again is just because he has trouble with my fourth brother. This matter is settled like this. Tie Zhu's child was not selected. It can only be said that he is not blessed. It has nothing to do with anything else. Tie Zhu, don't take it to heart. If it doesn't work, just go with him. Fourth uncle goes out, hehe, the fourth uncle of the Immortal Sect can't say anything, but if it is a mortal sect in the Jianghu, it is still okay for the Fourth Uncle to ask for face. Then you and your brother Huzi will go together, I originally planned to send him to the martial arts in the Jianghu for some experience. "
When Wang Zhuo heard this, he immediately laughed and said contemptuously: "Tie Zhu, I think what my fourth uncle said is fine. You can go ahead and tell others that you are a waste eliminated by the immortals. Maybe they will accept you as soon as they hear this."
Wang Lin slowly raised his head, his dark eyes dullly swept over the mocking relatives around him, and finally focused on Wang Zhuo, saying word by word: "Wang Zhuo, listen carefully, I, Wang Lin, will definitely step into the Immortal Sect in this life, and I will remember every mockery you and your father have made of our family."
Wang Zhuo sneered and was about to sneer when his fourth uncle frowned and shouted to Wang Zhuo: "You little bastard, you are so damn nagging. I will destroy you now and make you an idiot. I don't believe that the immortal will still want you!"
Wang Zhuo's father's expression changed drastically, he hurriedly stepped forward and pulled Wang Zhuo behind him, and said sternly: "Fourth, how dare you!"
The relatives around him all looked at the scene in front of them with sneers.
Fourth Uncle Tiezhu laughed loudly, with a cold light in his eyes, and said in a low voice, "Oh? Brother, you say I don't dare?"
Tiezhu's father hurriedly stepped forward and grabbed the fourth brother, and said anxiously: "Fourth brother, listen to the second brother. You have a wife and children at home, so you can't do this to the second brother. Second brother will remember your thoughts in his heart for the rest of his life. Fourth brother, you give me a ride, and your sister-in-law and I will take Tie Zhu home."
Tiezhu's fourth uncle stared at Wang Zhuo's father, sneered a few times, then took a deep look at his second brother, nodded, pulled Tie Zhu, and left the mansion with Tie Zhu's parents.
In the distance, Wang Lin could vaguely hear the taunting sounds of relatives in the yard.
Sitting in the fourth uncle's carriage, the family embarked on the journey home.
There was silence in the carriage, and Tie Zhu's father sighed inwardly. He would be lying if he said he was not disappointed, but Tie Zhu is his son after all. He sighed secretly and said, "Tie Zhu, what is this? It's okay. When your father was kicked out of the house, he was more depressed than you. Didn't you persevere in the same way later? Listen to your father, go home and study hard, and try to get good grades in the college entrance examination next year. If you don't like studying anymore, go out with your fourth uncle to relax."
Tiezhu's mother looked at her son lovingly and comforted her: "Tiezhu, don't do anything stupid. I only have you as my only child. If anything happens to you, my mother won't want to live anymore. Baby, you have to be strong." As she spoke, tears flowed down her face.
Wang Lin looked at his parents, nodded and said, "Mom, dad, don't worry, I won't do anything stupid. I have a plan, so you don't have to worry."
Tiezhu's mother held Tiezhu in her arms and whispered: "Tiezhu, what a blessing!"Everything is over, we don’t want to think about it anymore. "
The warm embrace of his mother gradually showed signs of healing for the wounds in Wang Lin's heart. Wang Lin had been too tired these past few days, mentally and physically haggard, and exhausted. With the ups and downs of the carriage, he gradually fell asleep.
He had a dream, dreaming that he became an immortal and flew around in the sky with his parents...
Late at night, Tie Zhu woke up. He looked at the familiar huts around him, sighed softly, his eyes flashed, and his inner plan became more determined. After leaving the hut, he took a deep look at his parents' room, picked up a pen and paper, left a letter, and left the house with enough dry food in his pocket.
“I will not give up on the road to seeking immortality, Heng Yue Sect, I must try again! Even if you still refuse, you must find out the location of other immortal sects. "Wang Lin looked firmly, carried the package, left the mountain village, and walked outside.
At this time, the moonlight was paving the road, and the star marks were pointing, pulling Wang Lin's back very, very long...
Three days later, Wang Lin was walking on a remote mountain road. He was pinched under the arm by a young man named Zhang that day. When he opened his eyes, he could vaguely see the general direction.
Keeping heading east, Wang Lin kept moving forward regardless of the weeds cutting his legs.
